cohort: 43 individuals with pathogenic variants in BRAF, MEK1, or MEK2 genes (CFC syndrome)
finding: Germline pathogenic variants in genes associated with CFC syndrome were associated with multiple congenital consequences including polyhydramnios, renal and cardiac abnormalities, macrosomia, and macrocephaly on second and third trimester ultrasound, as well as elevated rates of operative delivery and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Elevated rates of operative delivery were noted in individuals with CFC syndrome.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was 37 weeks
